alberta.title: Alberta Map
alberta.description: Discover Alberta’s places on any map. Open a place’s information to record your first visit and unlock its field notes here.
alberta.locked: Not yet visited. Find this location on the map to unlock this entry.

about.heading: Your expedition journal
about.description: This journal keeps your Alberta discoveries and expedition field notes together. The Alberta Map page is always available, and each expedition you start gets its own page.
steps: Open a base-map place’s information while exploring or flying to unlock its Alberta Map entry.
Start an expedition to add its page to this journal.
Complete checkpoints to record field notes about what you learned.
Record every note to reach the summit and earn a flag on your mountain.
about.saved: Your journal is saved in this browser. Alberta discoveries are saved separately from expedition checkpoints.
about.empty: You haven't started any expeditions yet.
